    EzySpeech Admin

    Settings

    These are the settings in config/config.yaml. Ports, secrets and the servers themselves only take effect after a restart. The admin password and the signing keys are held in config/secrets.key and are not editable here.

    Main server

    The listener server: the page the congregation opens.
    0.0.0.0 listens on every interface.
    Set this when the server is reached through a tunnel or a reverse proxy, e.g. https://your-tunnel.example.com. The admin panel then uses it instead of connecting directly. Leave empty for none.
    Never enable in production.

    Admin server

    This panel.
    Production needs this: the Web Speech API only records on a secure origin.
    Never enable in production.

    Authentication

    The admin password and the speaker accounts live in config/secrets.key and in the accounts list; neither is editable here.
    Seconds before a signed-in session expires.

    Features

    Duration, word count, peak viewers, translation calls, TTS plays and Bible references found. Shown in Session Stats.

    Bible references

    When this is on the server scans every finalized transcription for references such as "John 3:16", and fetches the verse from bolls.life. Verse text is shown under the caption and is not translated.
    A bolls.life code. Public domain: WEB, KJV, ASV, YLT, DARBY. Modern: NIV, NLT, ESV, NASB, CSB. Chinese traditional: CUV. An unsupported code returns nothing.
    How many verses one reference may show.
    Seconds to wait for bolls.life.

    Security

    The blocking limits are set high on purpose: a page refresh can trip a validation check, and a low limit locks out the room.
    "*" in development. Name your domains in production.

    Edit config.yaml directly

    Saving here rewrites the whole file and drops its comments. The fields above change one setting at a time and leave the rest of the file alone.
